snippet.title: The Last General - Trailer (September 2024)
snippet.description:
Wishlist "The Last General" on Steam:  https://store.steampowered.com/app/2566700/The_Last_General?utm_source=youtube_trailer
Join the Discord server: https://discord.com/invite/NEHxcg4q92

The Last General is a real-time modern war strategy game featuring many single player and multiplayer match types. Engage in deathmatch battles, assassinations, insurrections, sieges, protection, rescue, escape or survival missions and many more.

All battles are different, with billions of massive islands making every match exciting, challenging and refreshing.

The Last General immerses you into complex modern conflicts where you will need to capture strategic towns and cities, damage enemy's infrastructure, economic and productive capabilities, while defending and expanding your own.

You will develop your tactics guiding hundreds of groups of armored vehicles, artillery, infantry, supply and transport trucks through open field combat and close quarters city battles to achieve your high level objectives and defeat the enemy.

As a general you will have hundreds of strategies at your disposal to achieve your goals. Will you burn entire enemy cities to the ground and lose international support? Will you rush to the enemy's capital and risk being surrounded? Will you play an economic war capturing strategic enemy resources? Will you diversify your military or invest your resources in just one squad class?

What are you willing to do to be the last general?
